thread:
micah: Quick sync — final polish for launch readiness. Focus: SLA edge cases, support routing for Dedicated/Private, and last-minute pricing fallbacks.
anya: TL;DR what counts as "edge case" here?
simon: Mostly region failover, degraded GPU pool (burst -> dedicated fallback), and degraded quantized model outputs. Also 429 storms when caching warms.
leah: Docs ask: do we have deterministic messaging for customers when we failover? Need copy for status page + integration guide.
omri: Pricing: we need a temporary backstop rate for 24h emergency usage if customers get hot. Proposal: cap at 2x committed rate, auto-notify finance & sales.
micah: OK. For SLA: propose we keep SLOs but add explicit "grace period" clause when automated fallback triggers. Anyone opposed?
anya: Fine, but we must ensure runtime emits a routing_event with reason code. Engineers need a stable signal.
anya: (logs) example event:
```json
{"routing_event":"fallback","reason":"gpu_unavailable","model_variant":"gptq-8b-q4_0"}
```
simon: Perf team can surface that to tracing. We should also add a Prometheus counter `redwood_fallback_total{reason}` and a 15m alert if rate > 5/min for a tenant.
leah: I'll draft status copy: short blurb + customer impact table. Want to include recommended mitigation steps (e.g., switch to lower-latency model, enable caching).
omri: Sales notification: add SalesOps webhook when fallback counter spikes > 10 in 1h for enterprise tenants.
micah: Support routing: when fallback affects SLAs, route to P1 oncall; otherwise route to L2. Simon, can you codify rules?
simon: Yep — will add a playbook snippet in oncall runbook. Quick snippet:
```text
if fallback_reason in ("gpu_unavailable","region_outage") and tenant_is_enterprise:
  escalate -> P1 -> PM + Eng + Sales
else:
  alert -> L2 oncall
```
leah: Docs task: add an FAQ entry and example webhook payload. I'll target a PR by EOD tomorrow.
omri: Finance to approve 2x emergency cap for beta customers, enterprise will be case-by-case. I'll log in finance tracker.
micah: Owners / next steps:
- simon: add Prom counter + alert + runbook snippet (due 3890003000)
- leah: PR for status copy + FAQ + webhook examples (due 3890002000)
- omri: finalize emergency pricing policy + tracker entry (due 3890002200)
- anya: add runtime `routing_event` emission + model_variant field (due 3890002500)
micah: Thanks. If nobody objects, we'll ship these as part of the launch polish tomorrow. :thumbsup:
simon: +1
anya: +1
leah: +1
omri: +1
deploy-bot: Note: last deploy passed canary at 3890001220 — no blocking alerts in 10m.
micah: Perfect. I'll consolidate into the launch checklist and ping legal for final wording on the "grace period" clause.
